status: development prototype; not connected to the production API or dashboard
caveats: A ranking always yields a top province, even when conditions are uniform across provinces.
The five-province mean is unweighted: each province counts equally, regardless of population.
Balance Luzon is wider than CALABARZON; the regional hunger value is not a provincial measurement and is shown once per quarter.
No independent provincial outcome exists; neither layer has been validated against a measured provincial outcome.
D and its rank describe relative food-price pressure only.
The legacy composite (S1) is shown for continuity, in a secondary position, and is not validated.

provincial_layer.label: relative food-price pressure
provincial_layer.rank_rule: 1 = highest D; values equal after rounding to 9 decimals share the lowest rank of the group (1, 2, 2, 4); tied provinces listed alphabetically

legacy_layer.label: legacy composite, not validated as food insecurity
legacy_layer.rule: HIGH if S1 > threshold (strict), else LOW
